system_equations.velocity_gradient: D_t A = -A^2 - grad^2 p + nu Delta A
system_equations.strain_rate: D_t S = -S^2 - Omega^2 - grad^2 p + nu Delta S
system_equations.vorticity: D_t omega = S omega + nu Delta omega
system_equations.eigenvalues: D_t lambda_i = -lambda_i^2 + (1/4) omega_{perp i}^2 - (e_i . grad^2 p . e_i) + nu (e_i . Delta S . e_i)
system_equations.eigenframe: D_t e_i = sum_{j != i} [ (lambda_i + lambda_j)(e_j . Omega e_i) - (e_j . H_dev e_i) + nu (e_j . Delta S e_i) ] / (lambda_i - lambda_j) e_j
